summary_1line: Padmanabha the Naga returns home; his dutiful wife reports hosting a waiting Brahmana and urges him to meet the guest and uphold hospitality and restraint.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Naga chief Padmanabha returns home and his wife kneels to wash his feet as he sits after his long cosmic duty.
A lone Brahmana sits on the grassy bank of the Gomati River, reciting the Vedas while patiently awaiting the Naga's return.
